title: Megaflo Guide | G3 Cylinder Knowledge
description: Heatrae Sadia manufactures Megaflo unvented cylinders. Identify the model before applying air-gap advice, selecting controls or arranging service.
answer: Heatrae Sadia manufactures Megaflo unvented cylinders. Identify the model before applying air-gap advice, selecting controls or arranging service.

sections.heading: Identify the product family
paragraphs: Eco direct and indirect, Slimline, SystemFit, SystemReady, solar variants and larger Eco Plus cylinders need their own instructions. Many familiar domestic Megaflo models have internal expansion provision, but this is not a rule for every product with Megaflo in its name.

sections.heading: Why the distinction matters
paragraphs: A drip during heating, cold water at every hot tap and a single cold shower are different enquiries. Record the model label and symptom history so the investigation follows the correct circuit.

sections.heading: A useful service enquiry
paragraphs: Provide the brand, exact model, serial label if readable, heating source and postcode. Note whether the issue is water temperature, flow, discharge or a connected controller. The business can discuss the enquiry and establish competence, scope and availability; this guide does not promise that every product or component can be repaired.

sections.heading: Independent information
paragraphs: Manufacturer sources below identify the equipment. This website is an independent service business and is not claiming an official partnership with the manufacturer. Parts compatibility and current supply must be checked for the installed model.

faqs.question: Does the word Megaflo mean I can follow any Megaflo air-gap video?
faqs.answer: No. Identify the exact model and arrangement first; instructions for internal expansion do not apply universally across the entire Megaflo range.
